description: Send feedback to the Megido team: a bug, wrong or missing data, a feature request or anything else, with the ids of the projects or niches it is about. Send it when your user asks, and on your own when a call fails unexpectedly, the data contradicts itself or the corpus lacks something your user needs; then tell your user what you sent. Write what happened and what you expected, and leave out personal details the message does not need. Free, within a daily limit per organization: past it the call is refused with limit_exceeded. The organization sees its feedback and the team's progress on it in the portal.

items.description: Opaque niche id as returned by this server to your organization

kind.description: What the feedback is about: bug, wrong_data, missing_data, feature_request or other

message.description: What happened or what is needed, in plain words; for a bug, the call and what you expected
